_comment: Editor layout for the multi-component PCH model. A species is a brightness and an occupancy, so they render as pairs; switching a component off means zeroing either of its parameters, which is what add/remove do.

buttons.label: ➕ Add component
buttons.description: Switch on the next species with default brightness and occupancy.

buttons.label: ➖ Remove
buttons.description: Switch off the last active species (one always remains).

sections.description: Molecular brightness ε and mean occupancy N per species; a zero in either switches that species off.
